title: Finite affine stage refinement of an etale cover with representing maps
statement: Let X be a scheme, J a small cofiltered category, D:J→X_et an affine open diagram, and c its limiting underlying scheme cone with structural map p:c.pt→X satisfying c.π_j;D(j).hom=p [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-open-immersion]. Let I index an arbitrary etale cover z_i:Z_i→(c.pt,id), let W_i be etale X-objects, and let a_i:Z_i→p*W_i be representing arrows [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then there exist a stage j, a finite possibly empty set B, a selection r:B→I, affine etale X-objects V_b, arrows v_b:V_b→D(j) covering D(j), arrows w_b:V_b→W_{r(b)}, and arrows e_b:p*V_b→Z_{r(b)}, such that the family e_b;z_{r(b)} covers the terminal etale object of c.pt and p*(w_b)=e_b;a_{r(b)}. Refinement and repetition of indices are permitted. No sheaf or section occurs in this geometric assertion.

proof.text: Fix a stage and pass to its cofiltered tail, then to a directed coinitial system without changing the limit. Since all stages are affine, the limit is affine and quasi-compact. Apply finite affine etale refinement to the given cover Z_i, retaining its maps to the Z_i and representing arrows by composition. Reindex its finite sources by Fin n.

At the fixed directed stage, take its terminal etale object as affine target and pull each representing W_i back from X to that stage. Use p=π_i;D(i).hom and canonical pullback comparisons to convert the affine refining cover and its representing arrows into the input of etale_finiteCoverFactorizationDescent. Apply it to descend both arrow families under a common source comparison and obtain a covering at a later stage. It permits the auxiliary targets to be non-quasi-compact: morphism factorization is applied to the qcqs base-change diagrams of the affine sources, not to their target objects. Thus no separation or quasi-compactness of X is imposed.

Identify the later pullback of the fixed terminal etale object with the later terminal object. Compose model structure maps with the open immersion into X, and compose the representing maps with their projections to the original W_i. The common source comparisons followed by the maps to the selected Z_i give e_b. Pullback hom_ext and the descended arrow equations give p*(w_b)=e_b;a_{r(b)}. The family e_b;z_{r(b)} recovers the chosen limit refinement. The stage covering survives the terminal comparison and localization into X. The finite-cover descent handles the empty family, making an empty stage.

lean.statement:
theorem affineOpen_representing_cover_descent
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} {J : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory J] [IsCofiltered J]
    (D : J ⥤ X.Etale)
    [∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j).left] [∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (D.obj j).hom]
    (c : Cone (D ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X ⋙ Over.forget X))
    (p : c.pt ⟶ X) (hp : ∀ j, c.π.app j ≫ (D.obj j).hom = p)
    (hc : IsLimit c)
    (I : Type (u + 1)) (Z : I → c.pt.Etale)
    (z : ∀ i, Z i ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt))
    (W : I → X.Etale) (a : ∀ i, Z i ⟶ p.Etale.obj (W i))
    (hz : Sieve.ofArrows Z z ∈
      c.pt.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt))) :
    ∃ (j : J) (B : Type (u + 1)) (_ : Finite B) (r : B → I)
      (V : B → X.Etale) (v : ∀ b, V b ⟶ D.obj j)
      (w : ∀ b, V b ⟶ W (r b)) (e : ∀ b, p.Etale.obj (V b) ⟶ Z (r b)),
      (∀ b, IsAffine (V b).left) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows V v ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology (D.obj j) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows (fun b ↦ p.Etale.obj (V b)) (fun b ↦ e b ≫ z (r b)) ∈
        c.pt.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt)) ∧
      ∀ b, p.Etale.map (w b) = e b ≫ a (r b)
